Name: Disable Quest Notification (the pulsing)
Author: monsoonsheep
Description:
A mod to disable the question journal "!" mark pulsing when you have a new unread quest in your journal. 
Just a tiny change for quality of life purposes. 
Suggested by this Github issue in the mod ideas repository: https://github.com/StardewModders/mod-ideas/issues/1469

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Extract the .zip file in your mods folder using "Extract here"[/color][/size]

Manifest.Name: DisableQuestNotification
Manifest.Description: Disable the new quest "!" mark pulsing in the UI
